reviewNotes: Reviewed all 348 exported keys from 64 cards against data/adjectives.json furigana, adjective readings and explanations. Sentences, full explanations and complete answer clauses use 1.0; standalone adjectives, inflected adjective forms and short choices use 0.85. Contextual は -> わ selected by exact key/occurrence; lexical はつげん, はんのう, はっぴょう, はじめて, はし, はこ, はいった/はいって/はいり, はる, はちじゅっさい, はたち, はやい, はしる, はんとし and 歯は retained. Object を -> お; no directional へ, lexical へや, へた, へんか preserved. Residual kanji explicitly converted from source readings: 大げさおおげさ, 静かしずか, 賑やかにぎやか, 震えふるえ, 腐ってくさって, 支払いしはらい, 夜更かしよふかし, 豊かゆたか, 恵みめぐみ, 和らぎやわらぎ, 締め切りしめきり. Exported 落ちおちついて corrected to おちついて from 落ち着いて. Contextual 人でした corrected from にん to ひと, 世界中 from せかいちゅう to せかいじゅう, 一周 from いちしゅう to いっしゅう. Incorrect grammar distractors preserved as intentional choices. Katakana converted preserving long vowels/gemination. Display/lookup keys unchanged. Text review only; audible articulation and pitch accent not verified.
